title: Michael wonders who built the pyramids and the English standing stones

tellings.quote: How this stone got here in England? Them them them stones. Who who did this?

plain: Michael Johnson, one of the Air Force veterans on the show who say they were abducted, wonders aloud who really built the pyramids of Egypt and the standing stones of England. "How this stone got here in England?" he asks Michels. "Who did this?" He offers it as an open question, not an answer, and it hints that someone other than the people we credit may have moved those stones.
